Found by re-running the pattern case-insensitively and differencing the pattern variants against each other. LESSON: a case-sensitive gate reporting 0 is not a proof of absence.

hook_recommendation.note: RECOMMENDATION ONLY -- .claude/hooks/validate-no-task-references.sh was NOT modified and its severity was NOT changed, per the plan's Settled decision 4 and the task description's 'CONSIDER (raised, not decided)'.
hook_recommendation.summary: Escalate to a NEW PreToolUse deny (the existing hook is PostToolUse and structurally cannot prevent a write) scoped to Theories/**/*.lean, pattern '\btasks?([[:space:]]+|-)[0-9]+(-[0-9]+)?\b' case-insensitive, but ONLY with a sorry-line exemption. Keep the existing PostToolUse advisory for all other paths. Also add a duplicate-heading check.
hook_recommendation.false_positive_finding: Not hypothetical: the recommended regex matches ALL 14 immovable sorry-line residuals -- a measured 100% false-positive rate on the residual set. A blocking hook without a sorry-line exemption would be permanently unsatisfiable on 9 Theories/ files, because the only way to satisfy it is to violate the never-touch-sorry-lines rule. With the exemption (recommended -- it mirrors the sweep script's own guard and is self-maintaining as sorries are discharged), the deny surface on the current tree is 0 lines. A static path allowlist is discouraged: it rots as files move, which is the exact failure mode this task exists to fix.
hook_recommendation.pattern_corrections: Hyphen-aware (the current regex misses hyphenated adjectival forms like task-355, one of the 14). Case-insensitive (the -i flag is what would have caught TASK 344, the reference this task's own case-sensitive tooling missed for 7 phases). Digit requirement retained (a bare '\btasks?\b' would false-positive on 'WHOLE-TASK NO-GO' prose). Alternation of whitespace-or-hyphen rather than a character class, to avoid widening to 'task -320'.
hook_recommendation.path_scope_finding: Do not scope repo-wide: ~45 .claude/ files legitimately discuss task numbers (documentation about the task system itself), and lakefile.lean carries ~12 task-number references in lean_exe doc comments, so a repo-wide deny would fire on the build file on day one.
supporting_evidence: Phase 6 found two pointers that were not merely stale but FALSE: a 'proofs are deferred' note on a file that is entirely sorry-free and whose theorems in question are proved outright (Saturation.lean:960 -> subformula_property:996, blocking_sound:1212), and a citation to Filtration/SigmaOrdering.lean, a path that does not exist because the file was retired to Boneyard/FiltrationOrdering/SigmaOrdering.lean (Frame.lean:657). A reader trusting either would have drawn a wrong conclusion about project state.

Phase 7 found that a Phase-2 automated drop had collapsed three Formula.lean '### Complexity verification' headings into exact duplicates -- the task numbers were load-bearing as disambiguators, so a blocking gate must be paired with a positive disambiguation obligation and a duplicate-heading check, or it will push authors into exactly this failure.

Phase 8 found that the advisory hook's regex is STRICTER than this task's purpose-built tooling on the axis that mattered: the sweep pattern is case-sensitive and never saw all-caps 'TASK 344' at SharedWitness.lean:11516, while the hook greps -i and would have flagged it at write time. A one-off sweep inherits its author's regex blind spot; a standing gate catches the next variant. This is the most direct evidence in favour of escalation.

follow_ups: Meta task: hook escalation per the recommendation above (new PreToolUse deny, Theories/**/*.lean scope, hyphen-aware + case-insensitive pattern, MANDATORY sorry-line exemption, duplicate-heading check). The write-up in the summary is intended to make this one-shot.

Optional supervised decision: whether to permit a narrowly-scoped exception to the never-touch-sorry-lines rule for prose-only 'sorry' mentions. That single decision would unlock all 14 residuals plus the MergedBracketQuarantine pair, but the census invariant must be re-established on a different basis first -- it must not be folded into an editing phase.
Out of scope here, worth a separate pass: lakefile.lean's ~12 task-number references in lean_exe doc comments.
Method note for future sweeps: run gate patterns case-insensitively AND hyphen-aware, and cross-check two independently-written patterns before declaring a count.
